### A Flash of Insight
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/a-flash-of-insight
Passage: Ecclesiastes 2:24-25
Points:
- Human beings have no inherent ability to generate lasting satisfaction merely from their labor.
- Material riches and achievements cannot purchase true joy or internal peace.
- Genuine enjoyment of food, work, and daily living is a personal gift from God.
- Authentic and enduring delight is impossible apart from a relationship with God.

### Joy in the Present
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joy-present
Passage: Ecclesiastes 2:24-26
Points:
- Biblical faith does not endorse asceticism but commends enjoying God's good creation.
- Frustration over the impermanence of earthly toil is countered by appreciating present blessings.
- Finding true satisfaction in the work of our hands requires the grace of God.
- Rather than envying others' prosperity, believers are called to seek God for contentment in all circumstances.
